skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the nature of customer relationships
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the fundamental aspects of customer relationships and their management.
Analyze the quality and development of business-customer relationships.
Manage the various stages of the customer lifecycle.
Make strategic decisions related to customer relationship management.
Develop comprehensive strategies for managing customer relationships.
Conduct analysis and manage operations in customer relationship management.
Provide customer care and resolve conflicts effectively.
Work independently on tasks related to customer relationship management.
Collaborate effectively with team members in managing customer relationships.
